name: Hedda Rook
notes: Adult fitter, one of Sella Marr’s existing six civilian employees. Measuring proposed gate fittings, not installing or guarding a gate. Broad-shouldered, wool work jacket, chalk on her cuffs. No knowledge of Nimras or Vaur’s commission.

score.want: Finish an accurate estimate without assuming a property dispute.

status.strangers: Workmanlike equality; expects tools and measuring space respected.

tactics: Stop work and seek supervisor if pressured

name: Tovin Beck
notes: Adult assistant, one of Sella Marr’s existing six civilian employees. Carries tools and holds measuring ends. Work shirt and canvas apron. No knowledge of the mages or manuscript.

score.want: Help Hedda finish the job and get out of the damp.

status.strangers: Ordinary politeness, quiet around people arguing.

tactics: Withdraw with the tools if threatened
